name: hcg-core
description: HCG unhobbled development core — slim methodology (Operating Rules §0–§5 + work-routing table), Task-axis parallelism (parallel-tasks skill + one full-stack task-agent), doc-convention contracts/, HCG-stack conventions (Next.js App Router · MariaDB+Prisma · TanStack Query/Zustand/RHF/Zod · Vitest+Playwright), on-demand cross-model codex-review skill (closed trigger list, background, NOT a gate), a promoting-db-to-prod DB promotion skill (dump→restore→3-way verification, human-approved destructive steps), a read-only intake-audit skill (vibe-coded prototype triage — keep/repair/rebuild report with clause citations, intent-extraction mode for foreign stacks), 3 fan-out workflow templates (migrate · test-gen · converge), two hooks (SessionStart bootstrap-status; PreToolUse destructive-command guard on Bash|PowerShell only — the sole mechanical backstop on the --dangerously-skip-permissions headless path), and /hcg-core:init · :upgrade bootstrap (bootstrap.mjs engine, marker .claude/.hcg-core.json). hcg-harness (the legacy pipeline plugin) is migration-only as of 0.3.0 — it is not recommended for new installs and staying on it is not a supported path; install hcg-core for new projects and migrate existing hcg-harness projects to it. Do not install both plugins in one project.
